transform.description: Transform kind: "direct", "cast", "expression", etc. Stringified from `rocky_sql::lineage::TransformKind` to avoid pulling schemars into rocky-sql.

source.description: The column that influences row selection.

target_column.description: The single output column affected (window keys). Omitted when the edge affects every output column of `target_model`.

target_model.description: The model whose rows it influences.

direction.description: Direction of the trace walk: `"upstream"` (producers) or `"downstream"` (consumers). Defaults to upstream when `--column` is set without direction flags, matching the historical default.

downstream_consumers.description: Every downstream column that transitively consumes `(model, column)`, deduplicated and deterministically sorted. An author-time "what does changing this column affect" signal, always populated regardless of `direction` so the default (upstream) trace still carries the blast radius. Inspection only — this never feeds a build/skip/reuse decision. Empty when the column has no consumers.

row_selection.description:
Row-selection edges along the trace: columns that decide which rows or groups exist (join keys, filters, group keys, window keys) rather than feeding a value. `trace` stays value-derivation only.

Upstream: the row-selection inputs of every model on the value trace, for the traced column. Downstream: the models whose rows the traced column (or a column derived from it) filters, joins, groups or partitions. Omitted when empty.
